test_title: PYST 9: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 22 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter cluster in the same way as the fourth letter cluster is related to the third letter cluster, and the second letter cluster is related to the first letter cluster.

AWESOME : EWASEMO :: IMPRESS : PMIRSSE :: CONFUSE : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30dbf680205b2ac5ef3c42da1ffec8619642030da36e21c43297a3224c70e079.png] 

The logic followed here is,

**AWESOME : EWASEMO**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ecc2f229a21ec78fd4f0d93bd96c5430600c3b96afb1e01a72b6655e3b62e51a.png] 

**IMPRESS : PMIRSSE**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/acd4f176931a57994cebda4067fd88b404da46ed6873a9868ea6a13d6189c8b7.png] 

Similarly,

**CONFUSE : ?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/153ed699f511813e9aee99ae6bce39e7ac95c9e4a808717d22062bc45076136b.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"****NOCFESU"**.
